newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhstan creates single state oil pipeline firm.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan creates single state oil pipeline firm.

text.p: Kazakhstan is to create a single state-owned pipeline company for the export and import of oil and oil products from the former Soviet republic, the official Khabar Press news agency said on Monday.

The government decree, merging two state-owned pipeline operators, said the new National Oil Pipeline Company would "improve the observance of Kazakhstan's economic interests in the transport, export and import of oil and oil products."
